_comment: Live config. Both Gemini Pro-tier options are dead ends: gemini-3.1-pro-preview hit a hard 429 quota-exceeded (needs billing enabled, not just a low free allowance) and gemini-2.5-pro came back 404 'no longer available to new users' - a real decommission, not a rate issue. Per Jake: stop gambling on unproven models, use what's actually proven live today. unify now runs on gemini-3.6-flash, same as character/atmosphere (all three succeeded live in run 6-8). editor runs on gemini-3.5-flash-lite - a distinct GA model from unify's 3.6-flash, so it isn't literally grading its own output, while staying in the same reliable free-tier family rather than gambling on another provider. skeleton/action/summariser stay on Groq - their prompts never carry the full accumulated draft on top of canon.md's ~4.3k tokens, so they stay well under Groq's per-model TPM caps (character blew straight through gpt-oss-20b's 8000 TPM cap: 8978 requested). Known open issue: character/atmosphere have blown their change budgets (up to 96% drift vs 35-45% caps) on every real run so far and gotten discarded in favour of action's flatter draft - BUDGET in pipeline/passes.py was tuned for third-person incremental edits and first-person interior narration may just be a bigger rewrite by nature; revisit once a chapter completes end to end. Mistral is parked entirely: 429 rate_limited on the very first call, two different roles, two separate runs, before Groq's own error confirmed canon.md's size is the real constraint - worth checking its dashboard limits directly before trying again.
